chapter: Howard McGhee's band and bebop in LA
title: Rumor of a secretly recorded McGhee band
summary: A story that the band was secretly recorded through a ceiling microphone, which he does not know about.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: You were talking about recording with Howard McGhee in 1945. I remember talking with Roy (?).
Yeah, yeah, a good friend of mine.

He said somebody recorded the Howard McGhee band surreptitiously (?) on Western Avenue, by sending a microphone down through the ceiling, and there was recording equipment upstairs -- the band didn't know they were being
[LAUGHS] Well, those things happen, you know.
Was that when you were in the band that you know of?
No, that didn't happen while I was in the band -- that I knew of, you know; I don't know.
